summary.text: Tom Millett is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 2 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Navy veteran with a career as an energy consultant, he serves on the House Judiciary, House Rules, Fish, Wildlife and Parks, and Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations committees.

paragraphs.text: Tom Millett's career experience includes working as an energy consultant, and he has served in the U.S. Navy.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Southern California in 1965, was raised in Tucson, Arizona, served eight years on active duty and two in the reserves in the Navy, and was honorably discharged in 1991.

He said he then spent more than 30 years in the civilian nuclear and fossil power generation and telecommunications industries, and moved to Marion, Montana, from Las Vegas about 12 years before the survey.
Millett defeated Democrat Brad Simonis in the November 5, 2024 general election and assumed office on January 6, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations, House Rules, Fish, Wildlife and Parks, and House Judiciary committees.

In the 2024 survey he listed his campaign messages as protecting rights, pushing back against governmental overreach, and representing conservative and traditional values, and named the Second Amendment, lower property taxes and public lands access among his policy interests.
